Call from your Gorilla Engage line.
No answer. Hang up first.
Every customer who got a price yesterday and didn't sign gets a call from you.
After 8:45 AM, open Opportunities.
Switch the pipeline to Feedback Calls.
Everyone in To Call had an appointment yesterday, got a price, and didn't sign.
Each card is one customer, and each one has a call task due by 1 PM.
Don't move any cards yet. Moving a card is what sends texts and emails.
Click a card to open it.
Go to the Tasks tab.
The task shows the rep, the appointment, and the price they were quoted.
Read the rep's notes so you know what came up at the appointment.
The AccuLynx link opens the job if you need more detail.
The form link is what you fill out during the call. Have it ready.
Call them from your Gorilla Engage line.
They picked up. Go to Tasks and open the form link.
Their name and phone are already filled in. Don't change them. That's how the form finds the right customer.
Ask the questions in order and type their answers as they talk.
After you hang up, pick the main thing holding them back.
Then hit Submit.
Submitting posts the summary to #sales-feedback so the sales team sees it.
The card moves to Call Completed on its own.
Never drag a card to Call Completed yourself. If you do, nothing posts to Slack.
Submitting also marks the card Won. Here, Won just means the call is done, not that they signed.
That's it for this customer. The rep and the sales manager follow up from the Slack post.
Same call, same form. If they have a problem with the rep:
Under Where are you at, pick Rep issue.
It still posts to Slack, and the card goes to Send to Sales Manager.
Now drag the card from To Call to ATC 1.
About a minute later, a text and an email go out from your line automatically.
If you moved the card before calling and they answered, they'd still get a sorry-I-missed-you text. Always call first, then move.
Call them again tomorrow.
Next day. Call the people in ATC 1 again.
Missed again? Drag the card from ATC 1 to ATC 2.
A second text and email go out.
Try them one more time tomorrow.
One more call from ATC 2.
Still nothing? Drag the card to No Contact. Nothing gets sent.
Replies and callbacks come to your line.
Whatever stage the card is in, open the task and use the form like a normal call.
Submit posts to Slack and moves the card to Call Completed, even from ATC 2.
Every form you submit counts as one finished feedback call.
You get paid per form submitted. This dashboard adds them up by day and by week.
Only submit the form when you actually talked to the customer. A missed call goes to ATC, not the form.
One form per conversation. Don't submit twice for the same call.
That's the whole routine. Every morning, every situation.
